70 bool setsockopt_reuseaddr(bool reuseaddr)

97class UdsAddress : public Socket::Address {
98public:
99 explicit UdsAddress(const std::string &path = "")
100 {
101 m_address.sun_family = AF_UNIX;
102 string_utils::copy_string(m_address.sun_path, path.c_str(), sizeof(m_address.sun_path));
103 m_name.assign(path);
104 }
105
106 std::string path() const { return m_address.sun_path; }
107
108 const struct sockaddr *sockaddr() const override
109 {
110 return reinterpret_cast<const struct sockaddr *>(&m_address);
111 }
112 const socklen_t &length() const override { return m_length; }
113 socklen_t size() const override { return m_size; }
114 const std::string &name() const override { return m_name; }
115
116 static std::shared_ptr<UdsAddress> create_instance(const std::string &path)
117 {
118 // When no longer required, the UDS socket pathname should be deleted using unlink or remove.
119 auto deleter = [path](UdsAddress *p) {
120 if (p) {
121 delete p;
122 }
123 unlink(path.c_str());
124 };
125
126 // Remove given path in case it exists
127 unlink(path.c_str());
128
129 // Create UDS address from given path (using custom deleter)
130 return std::shared_ptr<UdsAddress>(new UdsAddress(path), deleter);
131 }
132
133private:
134 sockaddr_un m_address = {};
135 socklen_t m_length = sizeof(m_address);
136 const socklen_t m_size = sizeof(m_address);
137};

300class SocketConnectionImpl : public Socket::Connection {
301public:
307 explicit SocketConnectionImpl(std::shared_ptr<Socket> socket) : m_socket(socket) {}
308
314 std::shared_ptr<Socket> socket() override { return m_socket; }
315
323 int receive(Buffer &buffer) override
324 {
325 if (buffer.length() >= buffer.size()) {
326 // Buffer is full
327 return -1;
328 }
329
330 int result = ::recv(m_socket->fd(), buffer.data() + buffer.length(),
331 buffer.size() - buffer.length(), MSG_DONTWAIT);
332 if (result > 0) {
333 buffer.length() += static_cast<size_t>(result);
334 }
335
336 return result;
337 }
338
346 int receive_from(Buffer &buffer, Socket::Address &address) override
347 {
348 address.length() = address.size();
349
350 int result = ::recvfrom(m_socket->fd(), buffer.data(), buffer.size(), MSG_DONTWAIT,
351 address.sockaddr(), &address.length());
352 if (result >= 0) {
353 buffer.length() = static_cast<size_t>(result);
354 }
355
356 return result;
357 }
358
366 int send(const Buffer &buffer) override
367 {
368 return ::send(m_socket->fd(), buffer.data(), buffer.length(), MSG_NOSIGNAL);
369 }
370
378 int send_to(const Buffer &buffer, const Socket::Address &address) override
379 {
380 return ::sendto(m_socket->fd(), buffer.data(), buffer.length(), 0, address.sockaddr(),
381 address.length());
382 }
383
384private:
388 std::shared_ptr<Socket> m_socket;
389};

391class ServerSocketAbstractImpl : public ServerSocket {
392public:
398 std::shared_ptr<Socket> socket() override { return m_socket; }
399
408 bool bind(const Socket::Address &address)
409 {
410 if (0 != ::bind(m_socket->fd(), address.sockaddr(), address.length())) {
411 LOG(ERROR) << "Unable to bind server socket: " << strerror(errno);
412 return false;
413 }
414
415 return true;
416 }
417
426 bool listen(int backlog = 1)
427 {
428 if (0 != ::listen(m_socket->fd(), backlog)) {
429 LOG(ERROR) << "Unable to listen for incoming connections: " << strerror(errno);
430 return false;
431 }
432
433 return true;
434 }
435
444 std::unique_ptr<Socket::Connection> accept(Socket::Address &address) override
445 {
446 m_socket->m_name = address.name() + " server";
447 address.length() = address.size();
448 int connected_socket = ::accept(m_socket->fd(), address.sockaddr(), &address.length());
449 if (FileDescriptor::invalid_descriptor == connected_socket) {
450 LOG(ERROR) << "Unable to accept socket connection: " << strerror(errno);
451 return nullptr;
452 }
453
454 return std::make_unique<SocketConnectionImpl>(
455 std::make_shared<ConnectedSocket>(connected_socket));
456 }
457
458protected:
464 explicit ServerSocketAbstractImpl(std::shared_ptr<Socket> socket) : m_socket(socket) {}
465
469 std::shared_ptr<Socket> m_socket;
470};

546class UdsServerSocket : public ServerSocketImpl<UdsSocket> {
547public:
548 static std::unique_ptr<ServerSocket> create_instance(const UdsAddress &address)
549 {
550 // Create UDS socket
551 auto socket = std::make_shared<UdsSocket>();
552
553 LOG_IF(!socket, FATAL) << "Unable to create UDS socket!";
554
555 socket->m_name = address.name() + " server";
556
557 // Create UDS server socket to listen for and accept incoming connections from clients.
558 auto server_socket = std::make_unique<ServerSocketImpl<UdsSocket>>(socket);
559 if (!server_socket) {
560 LOG(ERROR) << "Unable to create server socket";
561 return nullptr;
562 }
563
564 // Bind server socket to given UDS address
565 if (!server_socket->bind(address)) {
566 LOG(ERROR) << "Unable to bind server socket to UDS address: '" << address.path() << "'";
567 return nullptr;
568 }
569
570 // Listen for incoming connection requests
571 if (!server_socket->listen()) {
572 LOG(ERROR) << "Unable to listen for connection requests at UDS address: '"
573 << address.path() << "'";
574 return nullptr;
575 }
576
577 return server_socket;
578 }
579};

581class TcpServerSocket : public ServerSocketImpl<TcpSocket> {
582public:
583 static std::unique_ptr<ServerSocket> create_instance(const InternetAddress &address)
584 {
585 // Create TCP socket
586 auto socket = std::make_shared<beerocks::net::TcpSocket>();
587
588 // Create TCP server socket to listen for and accept incoming connections from clients.
589 using TcpServerSocket = beerocks::net::ServerSocketImpl<beerocks::net::TcpSocket>;
590 auto server_socket = std::make_unique<TcpServerSocket>(socket);
591 if (!server_socket) {
592 LOG(ERROR) << "Unable to create server socket";
593 return nullptr;
594 }
595
596 // Allow reuse of local addresses.
597 // (to avoid the "address already in use" error when calling bind() on a TCP server socket
598 // if server has been shut down and restarted right away).
599 if (!socket->setsockopt_reuseaddr(true)) {
600 LOG(ERROR) << "Unable to set socket option";
601 return nullptr;
602 }
603
604 // Bind server socket to given TCP address
605 if (!server_socket->bind(address)) {
606 LOG(ERROR) << "Unable to bind server socket to TCP address at port: " << address.port();
607 return nullptr;
608 }
609
610 // Listen for incoming connection requests
611 if (!server_socket->listen()) {
612 LOG(ERROR) << "Unable to listen for connection requests at TCP address at port: "
613 << address.port();
614 return nullptr;
615 }
616
617 return server_socket;
618 }
619
620 static std::unique_ptr<ServerSocket> create_instance(uint16_t port)
621 {
622 return create_instance(InternetAddress(port));
623 }
624};
